about: Mirman, Markovits & Landau, P.C. is a personal injury firm with a single office in Manhattan.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock; it will visit clients in hospital or at home. It publishes material in English and Spanish.
